sources.quote: GLM-5.3-Flash pushes the Pareto frontier of the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.1.1, scoring 57 at just $0.045 per task (discounted)
GLM-5.3-FlashX is now live, delivering inference speeds of 200 tokens/s for faster responses and a smoother experience.
This kind of structured task input reduces unnecessary guesswork and makes the agent’s changes more consistent and easier to review.
Every agent diff is re-graded on a pristine image, and we publish both grades.
GLM-5.3-Prime is the high-speed variant of Z.ai's GLM-5.3, inheriting its full capabilities while delivering 1.5–2× the output throughput through inference acceleration.

METR 50% time horizon: METR's time-horizons page lists no GLM model
Aider polyglot, LiveCodeBench: no run found
multi-turn instruction following: not measured for Flash

AA v4.1.1 index: the 57 is quoted by Z.ai; no AA page shows that version, so it is recorded as the maker's quote and Z.ai's claim that GLM-5.3 scored 60 on it was not found in text and is not recorded
HF README: Flash's benchmark chart on Hugging Face is an image and its machine-readable results list three rows; the full table is in the data embedded in Z.ai's blog page
system_card: Z.ai publishes no system card or safety report for GLM-5.3-Flash
safety evaluations: no published refusal, over-refusal, sycophancy, prompt-injection or classifier results found

image, video and file input: Z.ai's page lists all three; Artificial Analysis lists image only, OpenRouter image and video, Fireworks image; Z.ai's API reference gives size and format limits (image 5 MB, video 200 MB, file 50 MB) but not the number of images or videos per Flash request or a video length limit
